about: RFC 6570 expansion vectors for the two expression forms compose supports, simple {var} and reserved {+var} (ledger #2132). The canonical copy is ikigai-fn's tests/vectors/uri_template_vectors.json, consumed by tests/uri_template_vectors.rs; a port (Python, Deno) keeps a VERBATIM copy and runs every case. 'variables' are the RFC's own example variables (section 3.2). Each template case is {template, out, source}: source 'rfc6570 section N' marks an example copied from the RFC, where every expression names ONE defined variable (compose supports no lists, no undefined variables, no other operators); 'ikigai' marks a case added here, with 'why'. The 'values' cases pin the per-value rule directly: html::url_segment is simple expansion, html::url_reserved is reserved expansion.

templates.why: the simple form of the RFC's {+path}/here: never the default, / is encoded
the case behind ledger #2132: a host-fixed page name with : reaches its target whole
the same name under simple expansion is one segment
reserved expansion passes a well-formed pct-encoded triplet through (RFC 6570 section 3.2.3)
simple expansion encodes the % of a triplet
a character outside U+R is encoded over its UTF-8 bytes in both forms
every reserved character passes reserved expansion

values.why: a % without two hex digits after it is not a triplet
a triplet passes as written, its hex case kept
characters outside U+R are encoded in both forms
